app.title: Shackleton: Night Shift
app.subtitle: A 30-day shift at the Moon's south pole
app.disclaimer: Independent project created for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Not affiliated with or endorsed by NASA.
scene.controls: WASD: walk · Mouse: look · E: use · Tab: tablet · Esc: release mouse
tablet.title: Command tablet
tablet.placeholder: The energy planner goes here (task C-03).
log.blackout: Partial blackout: not enough power even for the basics.
log.wasted: {amount} energy was wasted: the battery was full.
log.broken_reminder: {module} has been broken for several days.
log.storm.shelter: {level} storm: the whole crew took shelter (+{dose} mSv).
log.storm.work: {level} storm: the crew kept working (+{dose} mSv).
log.repair.failed: Could not repair {module}: the workshop did not have enough power.
log.rover.send: Decision: send the rover to look for ice.
log.rover.skip: Decision: keep the rover at base.
log.rover.departed: The rover left for the ice. It returns tomorrow.
log.rover.delayed: The rover hit rough terrain: it needs one more day.
log.rover.failed: The rover could not leave: the workshop did not have enough power.
log.rover.arrived: The rover is back with ice: +{amount} life support.
log.night_warning: Mission Control: in a few days the Sun will hide behind the crater rim. Charge your batteries.
event.reason.workshop_energy: You need at least 10 energy for the workshop.
event.reason.no_time: There is no time before the crew rotation.
